title: Primer evento de obstaculos a los 10 segundos de iniciar
request: Activar el evento de obstaculos a los 10 segundos de iniciar la experiencia. Los eventos siguientes siguen cada 45-90 s.

operations.source:
--============================================================
-- OBSTACLE SERVICE v3 · obstaculos invisibles e intocables
-- Primer evento a los 10 s de iniciar la experiencia.
-- Luego cada 45-90 s durante ~15 s.
-- Los parts 'obstaculos' son siempre invisibles y sin colision.
--============================================================
local Workspace = game:GetService('Workspace')
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService('ServerScriptService')
local CollectionService = game:GetService('CollectionService')

local OBSTACLE_NAMES = { 'crate', 'obstacle', 'obstaculo', 'constructionramp' }
local SCAN_EVERY = 4
local MAX_OBSTACLES = 6
local FIRST_EVENT_DELAY = 10
local EVENT_MIN_WAIT = 45
local EVENT_MAX_WAIT = 90
local EVENT_DURATION = 15

---------------- servicios (require perezoso) ----------------
local EntitySpawner
local DeliveryService
do
  local folder = ServerScriptService:WaitForChild('DeliveryServer', 10)
  if folder then
    local ok1, m1 = pcall(function() return require(folder:WaitForChild('EntitySpawner', 10)) end)
    if ok1 and type(m1) == 'table' then EntitySpawner = m1 end
    local ok2, m2 = pcall(function() return require(folder:WaitForChild('DeliveryService', 10)) end)
    if ok2 and type(m2) == 'table' then DeliveryService = m2 end
  end
end

---------------- 1) desactivar el evento Construction ----------------
local city = Workspace:WaitForChild('DeliveryCity', 15)
if city then
  task.wait(1.2) -- dejar que MapBuilder termine
end
for _, node in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged('ConstructionNode')) do
  CollectionService:RemoveTag(node, 'ConstructionNode')
  if node:IsA('BasePart') and node.Transparency >= 0.99 then
    node:Destroy()
  end
end

---------------- 2) registrar parts 'obstaculos' (invisibles, sin colision) ----------------
local zones = {} -- [part] = true
local obstacles = {} -- lista de parts obstaculo (ocultos por defecto)

local function isZone(inst)
  return inst:IsA('BasePart') and string.lower(inst.Name) == 'obstaculos'
end

local function isObstacle(inst)
  local n = string.lower(inst.Name)
  for _, name in ipairs(OBSTACLE_NAMES) do
    if n == name then return true end
  end
  return false
end

local function hidePart(p)
  p.Transparency = 1
  p.CanCollide = false
end

local function registerZone(zone)
  zones[zone] = true
  zone:SetAttribute('ObstacleZone', true)
  hidePart(zone) -- la zona nunca se ve ni se toca
  print('[ObstacleService] zona registrada (invisible): ' .. zone:GetFullName())
end

local function scanZones()
  local stack = { Workspace }
  while #stack > 0 do
    local inst = table.remove(stack)
    for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
      if isZone(child) and not zones[child] then
        registerZone(child)
      end
      table.insert(stack, child)
    end
  end
end

local function prune()
  for z in pairs(zones) do
    if not z.Parent then zones[z] = nil end
  end
  for i = #obstacles, 1, -1 do
    if not obstacles[i].Parent then
      table.remove(obstacles, i)
    end
  end
end

local function insideZone(inst)
  local node = inst.Parent
  while node and node ~= game do
    if zones[node] then return true end
    node = node.Parent
  end
  return false
end

---------------- 3) limpiar obstaculos fuera de zonas ----------------
local function cleanupOutside()
  local removed = 0
  for _, inst in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    if isObstacle(inst) and not insideZone(inst) then
      inst:Destroy()
      removed += 1
    end
  end
  if removed > 0 then
    print('[ObstacleService] eliminados ' .. removed .. ' obstaculos fuera de zona')
  end
end

---------------- 4) rellenar zonas con obstaculos OCULTOS ----------------
local function addObstaclePart(p)
  hidePart(p)
  table.insert(obstacles, p)
end

local function randomPosInZone(zone, halfH)
  local size = zone.Size
  local x = (math.random() - 0.5) * math.max(size.X - 6, 0)
  local z = (math.random() - 0.5) * math.max(size.Z - 6, 0)
  local y
  if size.Y >= 8 then
    y = (math.random() - 0.5) * math.max(size.Y - halfH * 2, 0)
  else
    y = size.Y / 2
  end
  return zone.CFrame * Vector3.new(x, y, z)
end

local function fillZone(zone)
  local size = zone.Size
  local count = 0
  for _, child in ipairs(zone:GetChildren()) do
    if child:IsA('BasePart') and isObstacle(child) then
      if not table.find(obstacles, child) then
        addObstaclePart(child)
      end
      count += 1
    end
  end
  local target = math.clamp(math.floor(size.X * size.Z / 60), 2, MAX_OBSTACLES)
  local added = 0
  while count < target and added < target do
    local crateSize = 3 + math.random() * 2
    local pos = randomPosInZone(zone, crateSize / 2)
    if EntitySpawner then
      local model = EntitySpawner.Spawn('Crate', nil, CFrame.new(pos))
      for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA('BasePart') then
          p.Anchored = true
          addObstaclePart(p)
        end
      end
      model.Parent = zone
    else
      local p = Instance.new('Part')
      p.Name = 'Crate'
      p.Size = Vector3.new(crateSize, crateSize, crateSize)
      p.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
      p.Anchored = true
      p.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
      p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(178, 132, 82)
      p.Parent = zone
      addObstaclePart(p)
    end
    count += 1
    added += 1
  end
end

---------------- 5) EVENTO DE OBSTACULOS ----------------
local function announce(title, lines)
  if not DeliveryService then return end
  for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    pcall(DeliveryService.Popup, p, 'Info', title, lines)
  end
end

local function setObstaclesActive(on)
  for _, p in ipairs(obstacles) do
    if p.Parent then
      p.Transparency = on and 0 or 1
      p.CanCollide = on
    end
  end
end

task.spawn(function()
  -- primer evento a los 10 s de iniciar la experiencia
  task.wait(FIRST_EVENT_DELAY)
  while true do
    prune()
    if #obstacles > 0 then
      setObstaclesActive(true)
      announce('🚧 ¡EVENTO DE OBSTÁCULOS!', { 'Cajas bloqueando las zonas de obstáculos. ¡Esquívalas!' })
      print('[ObstacleService] evento de obstaculos ACTIVO (' .. EVENT_DURATION .. 's)')
      task.wait(EVENT_DURATION)
      setObstaclesActive(false)
      announce('✅ Obstáculos despejados', { 'La ruta vuelve a estar libre.' })
      print('[ObstacleService] evento de obstaculos terminado')
    end
    task.wait(math.random(EVENT_MIN_WAIT, EVENT_MAX_WAIT))
  end
end)

---------------- bucle de mantenimiento ----------------
task.spawn(function()
  while true do
    task.wait(SCAN_EVERY)
    scanZones()
    prune()
    cleanupOutside()
    for zone in pairs(zones) do
      if zone.Parent then
        local ok, err = pcall(fillZone, zone)
        if not ok then
          warn('[ObstacleService] error en ' .. zone:GetFullName() .. ': ' .. tostring(err))
        end
      end
    end
  end
end)

scanZones()
print('[ObstacleService] listo · primer evento a los ' .. FIRST_EVENT_DELAY .. 's, luego cada 45-90s')
